versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.0 — Introduces the SNSwatcher prototype for turning watermark-detected local SNS comments into organized memory notes.

- Reads comments from a local text file or a local HTTP test page; does not fetch live websites.
- Appends only comments that pass watermark detection to MEMORY.md as category-organized topic summaries.
- Supports dry-run previews; normal runs append a self-contained block without overwriting existing memory.
- Treats feed summaries as third-party claims, not confirmed facts.
